no_lora_definition: Use frozen base Evo2 logits; retain the identical LoRA-generated candidate pool and selected Top-128 starts. Prior/ranking prior are zero for every arm.
pairing: Three seeds are statistical units. Share pool, starts, search seed, oracle checkpoints, optimization budget and evaluation boundary across arms within seed.
schedule: Randomize arm order within seed using scheduling seed 20260907; record GPU and start time.
evaluation_boundary: Lock Top-256 unique sequences by Design reward before frozen/LoRA NLL, Evaluation and FullMPRA scoring.
diagnostics: GC/homopolymer compliance is measured post hoc only, never used for rejection. Edit counts are descriptive, not a lower-is-better optimization target.
selection_history: Removing the edit cap was chosen after inspecting earlier results. This is a follow-up component study, not untouched confirmation.
resource_policy: GPUs 0-3 only; two consecutive observations with >=16000 MiB free. Launch one job first, then release other GPUs after 8 complete optimization trajectories. Never stop other jobs. Shared-GPU timing is not an exclusive-hardware benchmark.
budget_boundary: 15360 counts optimization-step sequence evaluations; initialization/final scoring, pool selection and post-hoc evaluations are additional. Repeated starts are not independent statistical replicates.
